entities.summary: Juho Eljas Erkko was a Finnish politician and journalist. He was the foreign minister and negotiated with the Soviet Union before the Winter War started. Erkko's father, too, was a politician and journalist, Eero Erkko; his son was a journalist, Aatos Erkko.
